Subject: March 30th Bulk Commodities Cut Over




Shane,

On Saturday, March 30th, Orica will cut over bulk commodity supply from Tasman Ridge to Dampier at Pilbara Logistics plant.

In order to accomplish cut over activities, we will need a technical representative(s) from Tasman Ridge at Pilbara Logistics plant to participate in the activities and to insure Tasman Ridge's interests and assets are protected.

Would you please make arrangements to have a Tasman Ridge technical representative(s) report at 12:00 noon, March 30th, to the Main Guard House at Pilbara Logistics plant and ask for Orica's Ronald Martin. Jorge is coordinating all the cut over operations.

If you have any questions about this, please contact me (at the numbers indicated below) or Ronald Martin at +61 8 9216 6911, ext 2511.

Thanks and best regards.

Howard
